patch.value: Enable governance duplicate-detection advisory mode and restore parent_reference=warn

value.author: claude-code
value.text: Closes the gap in fleet rollout pm-cli-website-rlws, whose title says 'all 18 pm package trackers' but whose completion note lists only 16 — pm-brief and pm-web were skipped without a stated reason. Verified live on a throwaway copy of this repo's real settings.json: creating an item whose title matches an existing one returns warnings=[likely_duplicates:pm-web-i98h] and still succeeds (advisory, never blocking). Also reproduced upstream pm-cli#710 in the process: 'pm config set governance_duplicate_detection_mode advisory' silently re-derived validation.parent_reference from the named 'default' preset and flipped warn -> strict_error with no stderr notice. Pinned back with 'pm config set parent_reference_policy warn', which promotes governance.preset to 'custom' and materialises this repo's own preset values explicitly. warn is required here because agents on parallel branches legitimately reference a parent that only exists on another branch until the merge lands; under strict_error 'pm create --parent' hard-fails. Verified after the fix: creating an item with a nonexistent parent returns warnings=[validation_warning:parent_reference_missing] and exit 0.

value.author: claude-code
value.text: Release attribution corrected to 2026.7.26 after review. The first attribution used the item's last-activity DATE, which is unsound: an item can be touched before the release that finally carried its code. Verified instead by tag containment — git tag --contains 62032c5 reports 2026.7.26 as the first release holding the implementation commit. Greptile caught this on PR #67 by noticing a historical release predating its implementation.

patch.value: Before this closeout the item had remained in_progress with no activity since its work shipped, so the delivery was missing from the changelog while still being counted as open work in every fleet audit. Closing it with an explicit release attribution is what added the historical entry.
A closed item whose changelog entry appears under the 2026.7.26 heading, the first release actually containing 62032c5, leaving the current release notes untouched.

Work completed and released in 2026.7.26. Release attribution verified by containment rather than by date: git merge-base --is-ancestor 62032c5 v2026.07.26 succeeds, so 2026.7.26 is the first release whose tree holds the implementing commit. An earlier revision of this record said 2026.7.25; that came from matching the item's last-activity DATE to a release and is superseded.
